newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber ends flat in light buying.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber ends flat in light buying.

text.p: Rubber futures ended steady on Friday in extremely light trade with most players sidelined by lack of fresh factors and a holiday in Thailand, dealers said.
"There was some shortcovering by local dealers and this helped prices hold at their current levels," a local rubber trader said.
"There was simply no interest in the market today. The holiday in Thailand depressed market sentiment," another rubber trader said.
Total volume for all three grades of rubber traded reached about 1,300 tonnes.
The most actively traded month was the March RSS3 contract with about 750 tonnes.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 was seen unchanged at 121.25 U.S. cents a kg.
October/December RSS1 was seen also unchanged at 177.50 Singapore cents (US$1.25) a kg.
March TSR20 was seen unchanged at 167.75 Singapore cents (US$1.18) a kg.
